name: pnp-spfx-copilot-components-m365-roadmap
title: M365 Product Roadmap
shortDescription: An SPFx 1.24 Copilot UX component for discovering Microsoft 365 roadmap features through the public Microsoft Release Communications MCP server.
longDescription: M365 Product Roadmap is a SharePoint Framework 1.24 Copilot UX component that helps users discover and explore Microsoft 365 roadmap features through the public Microsoft Release Communications (MRC) MCP server. The component provides both compact inline views and fullscreen responsive card grids for browsing upcoming Microsoft 365 releases.

The component supports advanced filtering and search capabilities including debounced search, product picker, status dropdown, exact roadmap ID input, and multi-select filters for release phase, platform, and cloud. It features lazy-loading detail dialogs with overview information, rollout timelines, metadata, and direct links to Microsoft source documentation.

Built with React and TypeScript using the SharePoint Framework 1.24, the component leverages @spteck/react-controls-v2 for UI controls and @emotion/css for styling with Fluent design tokens. It demonstrates best practices for integrating Copilot components with remote MCP endpoints, including offset paging with deduplication, stale-request protection, and light/dark theme support.
